title: 100 sites pe startup post karo
content:
Kya pata hai.
Is GitHub repo mein aao, to 100 alag sites milengi.
Wahan startup post karke beta users la sakte ho.
Ek warning bhi hai.
Woh khatam hone se pehle sunoge.

Pehle asli users lana sabse mushkil hota hai.
Paid ads unhe dhoondhne ka mehnga tareeka hai.

Reddit wale hisse se shuru karo.
Wahan exact subreddits likhe hain, jahan founders sach mein signups uthate hain.
Murda kamron mein post karke ban mat hona.

Reddit se feedback milta hai.
Agla list wahan hai, jahan se signups aate hain.
Uske baad launch sites aur communities hain.
Early adopters ke liye bani.
Log jo nayi cheezein try karne nikalte hain.
Wahi log adhoore products pe signup karte hain.

Schedule is list ko kaam karwati hai.
Roz do post.
Monday se Friday.
Ek launch day pe sab daanv lagane ke bajaye, 10 jagah se thodi thodi traffic aati hai.

Kul kharcha 0 dollar.
Aur roz copy paste ke kuch minute.

Warning hai, dead links.
Yeh list 2014 se chalu hai.
Maine aaj check kiya.
82 websites mein se 5 load nahi hui.
Post se pehle har ek khol lena.

Comment karo, launchpad.
Main repo bhej dunga.
